title: DataspaceProtocolDatasetBase
description:
Dataset interface compliant with Eclipse Data Space Protocol.

This interface extends IDataset and enforces DS Protocol-specific requirements
by overriding properties with more specific types and constraints.

**Requirements per DS Protocol:**
- `@id` MUST be present for dataset identification (REQUIRED)
- `odrl:hasPolicy` MUST be present as an array of ODRL Offers (REQUIRED)
- Array MUST contain at least one IOdrlOffer
- Each Offer MUST have `@type`: "Offer"
- Each Offer MUST have `@id`
- `dcat:distribution` MUST be present (REQUIRED)

**Type System Design:**
- W3C DCAT spec defines `odrl:hasPolicy` as optional singular `IOdrlPolicy`
- DS Protocol requires it as a REQUIRED array of `IOdrlOffer`
- Interface extension allows TypeScript to override inherited property types
- Standards packages (@twin.org/standards-w3c-*) follow W3C specs exactly
- DS Protocol-specific constraints are defined here

**Future Compatibility:**
- Currently only one Offer per dataset is supported
- Array structure allows future support for multiple offers

@type.description:
The type identifier for the dataset.
REQUIRED per Eclipse Data Space Protocol.

@id.description:
Unique identifier for the dataset.
REQUIRED per Eclipse Data Space Protocol.

hasPolicy.description:
Array of ODRL policies (Offers) as required by DS Protocol.

REQUIRED per Eclipse Data Space Protocol spec.
Must contain at least one IOdrlOffer.
Currently only single offer is supported, but array structure
allows for future multi-offer support.

distribution.description:
Distribution of the dataset.
REQUIRED per Eclipse Data Space Protocol.

allOf.description:
Base interface for DCAT Dataset without JSON-LD context.
This is the context-free variant of IDcatDataset, intended for embedding
dataset objects inline within other objects where the context is provided by the enclosing document.

@id.description: The unique identifier for the resource.

dcterms:title.description: A name given to the resource.

dcterms:description.description: A free-text account of the resource.

dcterms:identifier.description: A unique identifier of the resource.

dcterms:issued.description: Date of formal issuance (publication) of the resource.

dcterms:modified.description: Most recent date on which the resource was changed, updated or modified.

dcterms:publisher.description: An entity responsible for making the resource available.

dcterms:creator.description: An entity responsible for producing the resource.

dcterms:accessRights.description: Information about who can access the resource or an indication of its security status.

dcterms:license.description: A legal document under which the resource is made available.

dcterms:rights.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

dcterms:conformsTo.description: An established standard to which the resource conforms.

dcterms:type.description: The nature or genre of the resource.

dcat:contactPoint.description: Relevant contact information for the catalogued resource.

dcat:keyword.description: A keyword or tag describing the resource.

dcat:theme.description: A main category of the resource. A resource can have multiple themes.

dcat:landingPage.description: A Web page that can be navigated to gain access to the resource.

dcat:qualifiedRelation.description: Link to a description of a relationship with another resource.

dcterms:accrualPeriodicity.description: The frequency at which the dataset is published.

dcat:inSeries.description: A dataset series of which the dataset is part.

dcterms:spatial.description: The geographical area covered by the dataset.

dcat:spatialResolutionInMeters.description: Minimum spatial separation resolvable in a dataset, measured in meters.

dcterms:temporal.description: The temporal period that the dataset covers.

dcat:temporalResolution.description: Minimum time period resolvable in the dataset.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: An activity that generated, or provides the business context for, the creation of the dataset.

allOf.$comment: Inlined utility base type DcatDatasetBase so utility transformations can operate on concrete properties instead of a $ref.
